verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents natural-language interaction: it supports plain-English questions about the business, Accounting AI prompts run on the general ledger, and an MCP integration gives Claude conversational access to financial data. Claims that tasks can be 'described once, done automatically' hint at natural-language task automation, but most evidence covers querying and assisting, not operating the product broadly through commands. missing for 10: documented natural-language commands that execute actions across the product (posting entries, invoicing, reconciling), clarity on whether the MCP integration supports write operations versus read access only, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation — no exports, no copy-pasting.
described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
